stories.headline: AI *CRACKS* 167-YEAR MATH PUZZLE
stories.facts: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge used Claude to attempt a proof of the Riemann hypothesis in a 250,000-page Lean proof, while Stanford researchers published an independent human-made competing draft.
stories.caption_line: 🔢 Claude helps claim a proof for the famous Riemann hypothesis
stories.image_prompt: A dramatic photorealistic collage of a massive chalkboard covered in glowing mathematical equations and the Riemann hypothesis. In the foreground, a sleek futuristic server rack glows with electric-blue light. In the midground, a university lecture hall under warm studio rim light. Holographic floating numbers and data grids overlay the scene in electric-blue and warm-orange tones.
stories.source_title: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft

stories.headline: Signal *BLOCKS* Screenshots To Stop AI
stories.facts: Signal blocked screenshots on iOS and Android to prevent AI agents like Siri, Gemini, and Muse from reading private chats, though protection remains incomplete.
stories.caption_line: 🛡️ Signal restricts screenshots to stop AI agents from reading private chats
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic composition showing a modern smartphone displaying a secure chat app interface. In the foreground, a glowing red shield security overlay blocks a robotic scanning eye. In the midground, a dark minimalist tech workspace with soft rim lighting. Holographic data streams and privacy warning icons float in electric blue and warm orange.
stories.broll_query: smartphone screen showing secure messaging app
stories.source_title: Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats

stories.headline: Tech Stocks Suffer *Worst* Weekly Loss
stories.facts: The Nasdaq 100 entered a bear market after its worst weekly loss since the Covid-19 crisis, with Nvidia plunging 14 percent amid SEC reviews and AI doubts.
stories.caption_line: 📉 Tech stocks plunge into a bear market during a massive AI sell-off
stories.image_prompt: A dramatic cinematic shot of a Wall Street trading floor with giant screens flashing red downward stock charts. In the foreground, a high-end financial terminal glowing in the dark. In the midground, a modern skyscraper district at sunset. Holographic falling trends and data analytics streams in electric-blue and warm-orange hues.
stories.broll_query: stock market trading floor graphs crashing
stories.source_title: US technology stocks suffer their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as AI doubts pile up

stories.headline: Nvidia *BETS* Millions On Startup
stories.facts: Nvidia is nearing an acquisition of startup Inception for at least $500 million to strengthen its open-source Nemotron lineup with diffusion models.
stories.caption_line: 🤖 Nvidia targets startup Inception in a massive move for diffusion models
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage highlighting advanced robotics and artificial intelligence hardware. In the foreground, a gleaming robotic mechanical arm precision-welding futuristic microchips. In the midground, a high-tech cleanroom semiconductor facility. Holographic circuit patterns and data network nodes glow in electric-blue and warm-orange.
stories.broll_query: robot arm operating in high tech factory
stories.source_title: Nvidia bets at least $500 million on Inception's diffusion models to strengthen its open-source Nemotron lineup

stories.headline: Trump Threatens *Tax* For Data Centers
stories.facts: President Donald Trump promised to impose a tremendous tax on companies that build AI data centers outside of the United States.
stories.caption_line: 🏛️ Trump promises heavy taxes on companies building data centers abroad
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic scene featuring a grand government architectural building in Washington under a dramatic sunset sky. In the foreground, a sleek digital ledger interface with tax symbols. In the midground, towering data center server blocks. Holographic policy documents and monetary icons drift in electric-blue and warm-orange tones.
stories.source_title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US

stories.headline: OpenAI *SECURES* Model Reasoning
stories.facts: OpenAI strengthened safeguards against extracting internal reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol models, dropping the success rate to 0.2 percent and suspending thousands of accounts weekly.
stories.caption_line: 🔒 OpenAI tightens security to block attempts at extracting model reasoning
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic tech composition featuring a heavily secured server room with glowing blue status lights. In the foreground, a massive digital padlock overlaid with encrypted code streams. In the midground, rows of high-speed quantum processors. Holographic data security shields and network graphs glow in electric-blue and warm-orange.
stories.broll_query: cybersecurity code stream on computer monitor
stories.source_title: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think

stories.headline: Bytedance *INTRODUCES* New AI Agent
stories.facts: Bytedance and US universities introduced Axion 1.0, an AI agent that rivals top commercial models after only three training phases using carefully curated training data.
stories.caption_line: ⚡ Bytedance researchers drop Axion 1.0 using streamlined training phases
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic depiction of advanced neural network servers running at peak efficiency. In the foreground, a glowing open-source code architecture visualization. In the midground, a futuristic research laboratory under studio rim lighting. Holographic neural pathways and performance benchmark curves illuminate the scene in electric-blue and warm-orange.
stories.source_title: Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model
